description: This file defines the HTTP handler setup for the Kubernetes API server, including routing logic, web service registration, panic recovery, and error handling.

classes.name: APIServerHandler
classes.description: Struct managing the API server's HTTP handlers, including the full handler chain, web service container, and routing logic.

classes.name: director
classes.description: Internal struct responsible for routing HTTP requests to either gorestful or nonGoRestful handlers based on request path.

methods.name: NewAPIServerHandler
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new APIServerHandler with routing, web service container, and handler chain.

methods.name: ListedPaths
methods.description: Returns a list of registered web service paths for display or inspection.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Main entry point to handle HTTP requests, delegating to the full handler chain.
